limitations: k is the product of every stage rate and the output per turn, so optimism compounds: rates padded at each stage multiply into a k the loop will not deliver. Use measured rates and label estimates as scenarios.

Category weights and grade bands are fixed. The skill says to judge against the page's one goal, but the engine weighs a pricing page and a blog post the same way.
The fix list follows rubric order, not measured impact. The expected effect of each fix is a judgement, not a forecast.
engines.review: Whoever owns the page confirms each check against the live page on desktop and mobile and against its one conversion goal, and confirms conversion tracking works before any fix is credited with a lift.

engines.title: Win Loss Analysis
engines.decision: Which loss reasons, segments and competitors cost us the most revenue, and where should the fix start?
engines.inputs: A list of recent closed deals (won and lost) with outcome, segment, competitor, and any reason notes.
engines.outputs: A win-loss summary — ranked win/loss reasons, patterns by segment and competitor, no-decision rate, and prioritized fixes.

setup.runtime: Node 18 or newer for local runs; none for the hosted server

data_flow.path: Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server
data_flow.where: The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms.

data_flow.path: Hosted MCP server
data_flow.where: Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days.

limitations: Reasons, stages and amounts are what you enter. It cannot check them, and win or loss reasons logged by reps often differ from what buyers say; confirm with buyer interviews.
It tallies the win reasons and lost-at stages you give it but does not read interview notes or call recordings; that work stays with the skill.
The biggest fixable leak is the segment and loss reason with the most lost revenue, leaving out no decision and unspecified, which are reported separately. Decide yourself whether it is fixable.
A thin sample (under 20 closed deals or 8 losses) is flagged using this engine's own rule of thumb. With fewer, read any ranking as a hint, not a pattern.
engines.review: The sales lead confirms loss reasons are coded from deal evidence into a consistent set and that each top pattern rests on enough deals, before a fix is assigned to product, marketing or sales.
